description: This file contains implementation of tools for handling OMAP (address mapping) data used in symbol transformation, including functions for loading, building, and manipulating address mappings between original and transformed images, as well as related data structures and algorithms.

classes.name: AddressRange
classes.description: Represents a range of addresses with comparison method for sorting and range operations.

classes.name: OmapData
classes.description: Holds OMAP address mapping streams and original image length.

classes.name: ImageMap
classes.description: Contains the address mapping and endpoint index map for address translation.

classes.name: Mapping
classes.description: A vector of MappedRange objects representing address mappings.

classes.name: MappedRange
classes.description: Represents a segment of address mapping with original and transformed addresses, length, and injected/removed content sizes.

classes.name: EndpointIndex
classes.description: Represents an endpoint in the address space with associated index.

methods.name: GetOmapDataAndDisableTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves OMAP data from a DIA session and disables address translation.

methods.name: BuildImageMap
methods.description: Constructs an ImageMap from OmapData, building address mappings and endpoint indices.

methods.name: MapAddressRange
methods.description: Maps an address range from original to transformed space using the ImageMap.
